posts.title: Typst Stationery
posts.description: A web app and API that turns Typst stationery templates into finished PDFs — planners, journals, and paper goods generated from simple forms, including Hobonichi-style planner and weeks layouts.

posts.title: Tallpine
posts.description: An expert-led publishing tool that turns customer questions into briefs, drafts, and published articles, with managed WordPress and Payload publishing, plan-aware content autopilot, and per-site billing.

posts.title: BlockSignal
posts.description: An in-development fail-open blocker detection and recovery SDK for publishers, with separate blocker evidence and environment-health reporting.
